groups.title: be, have, not
groups.note: Is, is there, has, has not: the frame of almost every sentence.

chars.parts: 日 sun + 疋 foot set straight
chars.story: The sun straight overhead, the foot planted square: that is how it is.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'this'. Modern 是 is the verb 'to be': 他是老师 'he is a teacher'.

chars.story: A sprout standing in the earth: it is right there, at that spot.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'be there'. Before a verb it means '-ing': 他在看 'he is looking'.

chars.story: A hand holding a piece of meat: he has it.
chars.note: Also 'there is': 有人 'there is someone'.

chars.parts: - a bar across the top, three strokes held under it
chars.story: A bar slammed across the top, everything held down beneath it: not.
chars.note: Same as the Analects. 不 says 'not' for most verbs; 没 says it for 有 and for what did not happen.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 殳 hand with a tool
chars.story: A hand reaches down into the water and the thing is gone: none left.
chars.note: Before a verb: 'did not': 他没来 'he didn't come'. Traditional 沒.

groups.title: grammar markers
groups.note: Small words that carry grammar, not things. Learn what they do.

chars.story: A white ladle passes from the owner's bowl to the thing he owns: of.
chars.note: Three grammar words to tell apart: 的 before a noun (我的书), 得 after a verb, 地 before a verb.

chars.story: A child wrapped up tight, arms tucked away, the job finished: completed.
chars.note: After a verb the action is done (吃了 'ate'); at the end of a sentence something has changed.

chars.parts: 丿 slash + 厶 a twist
chars.story: A small twist tied onto the end of another word.
chars.note: Never alone: 什么 'what', 怎么 'how', 这么 'so'. Traditional 麼.

chars.story: Covers pulled over your skin: a quilt, and you lie under whatever is done to you.
chars.note: Before a doer and a verb, 被 makes the passive: 他被打了 'he was hit'.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: 人 squeezed onto the left: a person doing something.

chars.story: Another person standing beside you, also one of us: he.
chars.note: 她 with 女 is 'she'; 它 is 'it' (stage 3).

chars.parts: 亻 person + 尔 you (old form)
chars.story: A person plus 尔, the old word for 'you': you, face to face.
chars.note: 尔 is the classical 'you' (爾). The polite 'you' is 您.

chars.story: People crowding through a gate together: more than one.
chars.note: Only after pronouns and words for people: 我们, 朋友们. Traditional 們: 門 became 门.

chars.story: A person suddenly up and busy with his hands: at work.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'create'. That sense lives on in 作品 'work of art' and 作家 'writer'.

chars.story: A person up alone at dawn: the rest asleep, but not him.
chars.note: Also 'only' in a few words: 不但 'not only'.

groups.title: person 人 on top
groups.note: 人 spread like a roof over the rest.

chars.story: Two legs striding: a person.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.parts: 人 roof + 丨 one upright stroke
chars.story: One upright stick under a roof: one single item of anything.
chars.note: A noun after a number needs a counter: 一个人 'one person'. 个 is the all-purpose one. Traditional 個.

chars.story: People gathering like clouds under one roof: they meet.
chars.note: Before a verb: 'can, will': 我会说 'I can speak', 他会来 'he will come'. Traditional 會.

groups.title: size and number
groups.note: How many, how much, how whole.

chars.story: One stroke: one.
chars.note: Also 'as soon as': 一…就 'as soon as … then'.

chars.parts: - a hook between two small dots
chars.story: A thin hook between two specks, everything tiny: small.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: Evening piled on evening, night after night: many.
chars.note: Also 'how': 多大 'how big, how old'.

chars.parts: 曰 sun shape + 取 take
chars.story: Of everything under the sun, he takes the biggest: most.
chars.note: Before an adjective: 最大 'biggest'.

chars.story: Jade kept safe under a roof, not a chip missing: whole.
A knife splits the thing into two halves: divide.
chars.note: Also 'minute' and 'point' in a score.

groups.title: big 大
groups.note: 大 is a man with his arms spread wide.

chars.parts: - a man with arms spread wide
chars.story: A man stretching his arms as wide as they go: big.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: The one great sky above a man, rising each morning: a day.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'heaven'. Modern 天 is mostly 'day', and 'sky' in 天气.

chars.story: A big fat sheep: a fine, beautiful sight.
chars.note: 美 alone often means America: 美元 'US dollar'.

groups.title: people and the state
groups.note: Country, people, government, law.

chars.story: The jade treasure kept inside a border: a country.
chars.note: His card is 國: the 或 inside became 玉 jade. His keyword: 'state'.

chars.parts: - an eye pierced by a spike (an old picture of a captive)
chars.story: Once the mark of a blinded captive; now the common people.
Tapping things until they stand upright: government.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.parts: 丶 flame + 王 lamp stand
chars.story: The flame on the lamp in the main hall, lit for the master.
chars.note: Also 'main': 主要.

chars.story: The private split wide open: public.
chars.note: Also 'male' of animals, and in 公里 'kilometre'.

chars.story: Water goes only where the land lets it: a law.
chars.note: Also 'method, way': 方法, 办法. 法国 is France.

groups.title: walk 辶
groups.note: 辶 is a road under the feet: going somewhere.

chars.story: Walk up to the writing right here: this one.
chars.note: Traditional 這: 言 inside became 文. 这 'this', 那 'that'.

chars.story: Walking on inch by inch until you are past it: pass.
chars.note: His card is 過 'mistake': 咼 became 寸. After a verb, 'have ever': 去过 'have been'.

chars.story: Walk up to the well's square frame and step in: enter.
chars.note: Traditional 進: the bird 隹 became 井.

groups.title: linking words
groups.note: They join words and clauses, and say how they relate.

chars.parts: - a beard hanging from the chin
chars.story: The beard flows on below the chin: the clause goes on, and yet.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.parts: - a shape cut down from 與, hands passing something
chars.story: Hands passing one thing between them: together with.
chars.note: His card is 與: the four hands are gone. Formal 'and': 我与你.

chars.story: A person working with a plough: by means of it.
chars.note: Modern 以 lives mostly inside words: 可以 'can', 所以 'so', 以前 'before'.

chars.parts: - a hook hanging from a bar
chars.story: A hook hanging at the bar: at, in, to.
chars.note: Simplified 於 also became 于. Mostly inside words now; after an adjective 'than'.

chars.parts: - four strokes cut down from 為, a hand leading an elephant
chars.story: A hand leads an elephant to work: it acts as the labourer.
chars.note: His card is 為, cut down to four strokes. Also 'for': 为了 'in order to'.

chars.story: A small thing placed in the hand just then: when.
chars.note: Also 'act as': 当老师 'be a teacher'. Traditional 當: the 田 at the foot became 彐.

groups.title: where things are
groups.note: Above, below, inside, in front, behind.

chars.parts: - a short stroke above the line
chars.story: A mark above the line: above.
chars.note: After a noun, 'on': 桌上 'on the table'. As a verb, 'go up'.

chars.parts: - a stroke hanging under the line
chars.story: A mark hanging under the line: below.
chars.note: Also 'next' (下次 'next time') and 'go down'.

chars.story: A line driven straight through the middle of a box.
chars.note: Also 'in, during': 在…中.

chars.story: Fields walled round with earth: everything kept in the interior.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'village'. Now mostly 'in, inside': 家里 'at home'.

chars.parts: 丷 horns + 月 boat + 刂 knife
chars.story: A boat cutting the water with its knife-sharp prow: the front.
chars.note: In time, 'before, ago': 三年前 'three years ago'.

chars.parts: - a slanted roof over 一 and 口 mouth
chars.story: A mouth speaking from behind a slanted wall, last to speak: after.
chars.note: Traditional 後. The shape 后 was also 'queen'.

chars.story: Earth spread out flat beneath you: the ground.
chars.note: As a grammar word, before a verb: 慢慢地走 'walk slowly'.

groups.title: before the verb
groups.note: Small words that sit before the verb and change its force.

chars.story: A hook catching one more thing on the line: also.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'full stop'. Modern 也 means 'also', before the verb: 我也去.
chars.akw: full stop: that's how it is

chars.parts: 者 the one who + 阝 town
chars.story: Every one who lives in the town: all of them.
chars.note: Before the verb: 我们都去 'we all go'. In 首都 it is 'capital city'.

chars.story: Walking, but not there yet: still.
chars.note: Also 'give back': 还给. Traditional 還.

chars.story: Reach the tall gate of the capital, and then you are there.
chars.note: Before the verb: 'right then, just': 我就来 'I'm coming right now'.

groups.title: days and years
groups.note: The calendar.

chars.parts: - the sun with a mark inside
chars.story: The sun's round disc, squared off.
chars.note: Also 'day' (formal) and 日本 'Japan'.

chars.story: A crescent moon.
chars.note: Also 'month': 一月 'January'.

chars.parts: - a man carrying grain on his back
chars.story: A man carries the harvest home on his back: one year.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

groups.title: coming and going
groups.note: Movement in and out.

chars.story: Wheat, the gift that came from heaven: come.
chars.note: His card is 來: the two 人 inside became one stroke.

chars.parts: - a sprout climbing out of a pit
chars.story: A sprout pushing up and out of its pit: go out.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: An arrow lands at its mark: you have arrived.
chars.note: After a verb, the action reached its goal: 找到 'found'.

chars.story: A crossroads, left half and right half of the street: walk.
chars.note: Also 'do, carry out' (进行), 'OK!' (行), and 'firm' in 银行 'bank'.

chars.parts: - a cursive shape cut down from 發
chars.story: A bowstring let go, feet rushing off after the arrow: send out.
chars.note: His card is 發 'set off'. 发 also stands for 髮 'hair': 头发.

chars.story: Clouds driven by force across the sky: move.
chars.note: Traditional 動: 重 heavy on the left became 云.

chars.parts: 纟 silk + 圣 warp threads
chars.story: Warp threads running straight through the loom: pass through.
chars.note: Also 'classic book': 经典. Traditional 經.

groups.title: see, say, learn
groups.note: Taking things in and giving them out.

chars.story: A hand raised to shade the eye: look at.
chars.note: Also 'read' (看书) and 'watch' (看电视).

chars.story: Jade catching the light, there to be seen: it appears.
chars.note: In 现在 'now' and 现代 'modern' it means 'present'. Traditional 現.

chars.parts: 讠 words + 兑 open mouth
chars.story: Words pouring out of a wide-open mouth: say.
chars.note: His card is 說 'speak': 訁 on the left became 讠.

chars.parts: ⺍ three dots + 冖 cover + 子 child
chars.story: A child under a roof, sparks flying over its head: learning.
chars.note: His card is 學: the top (hands and crossed lines) became three dots.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: Something said, eaten or held in the mouth.

chars.story: A mouth tacked onto the end of the sentence: is that so?
chars.note: At the end of a sentence it makes a yes-no question: 你好吗? Traditional 嗎.

chars.story: Grain for every mouth, you and me: and, in peace.
chars.note: Joins nouns: 我和你 'you and me'. Also 'peace, harmony'.

chars.story: A mouth that says 'yes, nail it down': it can be done.
chars.note: Same as the Analects; 可是 'but' is modern.

chars.parts: 冂 cover + 一 one + 口 mouth
chars.story: One cover over every mouth: all the same.
chars.note: Also 'with, together'.

groups.title: inch 寸
groups.note: 寸 is a hand with a dot at the wrist: holding, measuring.

chars.story: The sun moving across the sky inch by inch: time.
chars.note: His card is 時: 寺 on the right became 寸.

chars.story: Two hands meeting exactly, palm to palm: correct.
chars.note: Before a person or thing: 'to, toward': 对他说 'say to him'. Traditional 對.

chars.parts: 彳 step + 旦 shell (cut down) + 寸 hand
chars.story: Out on the road, a hand closes on a shell: get.
chars.note: After a verb, 得 links to how: 说得好 'speaks well'.

groups.title: roof 宀
groups.note: 宀 is a roof: something sheltered in a house.

chars.story: A pig under the roof: a household, a home.
chars.note: Also an expert: 作家 'writer', 专家 'expert'.

chars.story: Under a roof, everything upright and in its place: fixed.
chars.note: The foot of 正 is slanted here.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 头 strings of coins (cut down)
chars.story: A house stacked with strings of coins: solid, real wealth.
chars.note: Traditional 實: the coin-strings 貫 under the roof became 头.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: 女 is a woman kneeling, hands folded.

chars.story: A woman holding her child: good.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'love / good'. The 'love' sense (好学 'love learning') is rarer now.

chars.story: A woman doing just as the mouth tells her: as.
chars.note: Same as the Analects; 如果 'if' is the modern use.

chars.story: A woman with her hands on her waist, demanding: want.
chars.note: Also 'will, must': 我要走了 'I'm about to go'.

groups.title: tree 木
groups.note: 木 is a tree: wood, plants, things made of wood.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 一 mark at the base
chars.story: A mark at the foot of the tree: its root.
chars.note: Also a counter for books (一本书) and 'this, one's own'.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 几 small table
chars.story: A wooden frame set on a stand: a loom, a machine.
chars.note: Also 'chance': 机会. Traditional 機.

chars.parts: 亲 tree on a stand + 斤 axe
chars.story: An axe chops into a standing tree: fresh-cut wood, new.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

groups.title: town 阝
groups.note: 阝 on the right is a town.

chars.story: A town split up into its quarters: a part.
chars.note: Also 'ministry' and a counter for films and books.

chars.parts: 冄 an old shape + 阝 town
chars.story: That town over there, far off: that.
chars.note: 这 'this', 那 'that'. With 口, 哪 is 'which?'.

groups.title: open and close
groups.note: A gate opened and a gate barred.

chars.parts: - the bar and two posts of 開, without its gate
chars.story: Hands lift the bar off the posts: open.
chars.note: Traditional 開: the gate 門 around it was dropped.

chars.story: Two bolt-tips sticking up over the great crossbar: the gate is closed.
chars.note: Also 'concern': 关系, 关于. Traditional 關: the gate 門 was dropped.

groups.title: it and its
groups.note: Classical pointing words that live on in modern words.

chars.story: A foot stepping from one word to the next: of.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'it / of / go'. Modern prose keeps the 'of' in fixed words.

chars.parts: - a winnowing basket on a stand
chars.story: A basket holding his own grain: his, its.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: A door and an axe: the place where a thing is done.
chars.note: Also 'place': 场所. 所以 'so', 所有 'all'.

groups.title: work and results
groups.note: Labour, trade, the matter in hand, its use and its finish.

chars.story: A carpenter's square: work done by hand.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'tool'. That sense is now 工具.

chars.parts: - five uprights on a base, the top of 業
chars.story: A rack of uprights in a workshop: a trade, an industry.
chars.note: Traditional 業: only its top is kept.

chars.parts: - a hand holding up an official's tally
chars.story: A hand holding up the tally of business: a matter to see to.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'serve'. Modern 事 is 'thing, matter': 有事 'busy'.

chars.story: A bucket put to work: use.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: A halberd with its last nail driven home: complete.
chars.note: Also 'become, turn into': 成为, 变成.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: Old pictures, best learned whole.

chars.story: A hand gripping my own halberd: I.
chars.note: Same as the Analects.

chars.story: A nose: you point to it to mean yourself.
chars.note: Also 'from': 来自 'come from'.

chars.parts: - a dot over a hooked frame
chars.story: A signpost dot over a frame, pointing the way: direction.
chars.note: Also 'side, way': 双方 'both sides', 方法 'method'.

chars.parts: - a baby, arms out, legs swaddled
chars.story: A swaddled baby waving its arms: a child.
chars.note: His card: 'child / Master'. Modern 子 is often a noun ending: 桌子 'table'.

chars.parts: - a shoot growing up from the ground
chars.story: A shoot pushing up out of the ground: life.
chars.note: Also 'be born, produce, raw': 生产 'produce'.

chars.parts: - a bear: head, body, two sets of claws
chars.story: A bear rearing up on its claws: strong and able.
chars.note: Also 'energy': 能源.

sentences.en: We're leaving the day after tomorrow.
He was home alone at the time.
This is definitely the best way.
I went to middle school in Japan.
It looks like he'll be coming here next month.
All this is new to me.
Are you still working for us?

sentences.zh: 我是日本人，而你是美国人。
sentences.en: I am Japanese, but you are an American.

sentences.zh: 你要不在了，那我就不在了。
sentences.en: If you were gone, I'd die.

sentences.zh: 他没说到关于他的那部分。
sentences.en: He kept back the part about himself.
